title: US-12 DFD: save a favorite

flows.label: Owned complete recipe and ownership data

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
POST /favorites is collection creation that references a recipe. Validate its body recipeId ownership before the association is saved.
Repeated saves upsert the same account/recipe key and produce one favorite.
No inventory write occurs: recipe, shopping, favorite and history actions never deduct or restock fridge ingredients.
Saving alone has no recipe-view write; a prior detail view may already exist.
